title.rendered: You Are Hidden with Christ in God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Your life is hidden with Christ in God. Not exposed, not vulnerable, not at the mercy of circumstances. To reach you, anything that wants to harm you would have to go through God first, then through Christ. That is the security you live in.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, May 13, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.”
Colossians 3:3 (NIV) | ESV

Today’s Message

Eight words. But the security they describe is immeasurable.

Your life is hidden with Christ in God. Hidden. Not displayed, not exposed, not vulnerable to the attacks of the enemy or the shifting winds of circumstance. Hidden. Tucked away in the safest place in the universe, inside Christ who is himself inside God.

To reach you, anything that wants to harm you would have to go through God first. Then through Christ. Then find you, hidden inside both. Paul is describing a security that is not theoretical but positional. By virtue of your union with Christ, you occupy a place in God that nothing outside of God can access.

The context of this verse matters. Paul is writing to people who have died to their old self and been raised with Christ. The death and resurrection are not future events awaiting them. They have already happened spiritually. Galatians 2:20 captures the same reality: “I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.” The life you now live is not a renovated version of the old life. It is a completely new life, hidden with Christ in God.

This changes how you face opposition. When something comes against you, it is not coming against a vulnerable, exposed individual managing life in their own strength. It is coming against someone whose life is hidden with Christ in God. That is a very different confrontation.

Prayer

Father, thank You that my life is hidden with Christ in You. I am not exposed and vulnerable. I am secure, tucked away in the safest place in existence. Nothing can reach me without passing through You first. I rest in that security today and I refuse the lie that I am unprotected. In Jesus name. Amen.

Declaration

My life is hidden with Christ in God. I am not exposed to the schemes of the enemy. I am not at the mercy of circumstances. I am secure in the safest place in the universe, inside Christ who is inside God. I live from that hidden, protected, unshakeable place today.
